brief:
Israeli soldiers stormed and searched homes in Yasouf, a town east of Salfit in the occupied West Bank, the Wafa news agency reported. The operation involved multiple house-to-house searches across the community.

Israeli forces simultaneously set up checkpoints in Bethlehem, restricting movement in the area. No additional details on the stated purpose of the operations or their duration were immediately available.
dek: Israeli forces search homes in Yasouf, set up checkpoints in Bethlehem Israeli soldiers have stormed and searched homes in the town of Yasouf, east of Salfit in the occupied West Bank, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli forces raid homes in Yasouf, establish checkpoints in Bethlehem
